faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Project Associate-I position at IIT Jammu is 30 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E. degree in CSE/IT/ECE/EE or an equivalent qualification, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Jammu Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-I position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Jammu website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 1 year of experience with Android, Linux, and Windows systems, and working knowledge of Information Security and penetration tools.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
